review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is believed that by some people that advertising can impacts on economic, others say that it has negative social influence; it will make people dissatisfied with who they are have. In my opinion, there are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

Those who advocate emphasize that advertising bring undeniable economic benefits. Since, advertising is a powerful driver of economic growth. With its engaging content and appealing visual effects, customer demand can be stimulated, meaning that buying power and production can be on the increase. This contributes to more employment opportunities and greater revenues through taxation and this can offer to a stronger economy. For example, e-commerce platforms such as Shopee or Lazada in Vietnam are relied heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Furthermore, jobs can be advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design, making it an important driver on economic activity.

However, others believe that advertising has negative social consequences. Since, advertising constantly shows images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards or luxury possessions which foster dissatisfaction among viewers. For instance, young people may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook, leading to frustration when they not afford them. It naturally follows that advertising promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
Overall, I think that both views are valid to some certain extent; advertising may contributed to social dissatisfaction, but its play a crucial role in economic development.

completion.comment: Ảnh đủ hai trang và bài có Introduction, hai Body cùng Conclusion.

review.overall: Em đã viết đủ bốn đoạn trên hai trang. Body 1 có được chuỗi demand–production–tax và ví dụ Shopee/Lazada, còn Body 2 đã nối luxury possessions tới dissatisfaction, pressure và frustration. Em cần sửa cấu trúc câu, đặc biệt sau Since và khi dùng advertising làm chủ ngữ, rồi viết Conclusion bằng hai câu ngắn.

paragraphs: Some people believe that advertising has economic benefits, whereas others think that it creates negative social effects by making people dissatisfied with their lives and possessions. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Engaging content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand, encouraging people to spend more on goods and services. As demand rises, firms can increase production, creating employment opportunities and generating greater state revenue through taxation. This can be clearly seen in e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam, which rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers and expand the digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising itself creates direct jobs in marketing, media and design, making the industry an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. Advertisements constantly display perfect lifestyles, beauty standards and luxury possessions, which may foster dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people in particular may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook. When these items are beyond their budget, this pressure can lead to frustration. In the long run, repeated exposure to such messages may promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture, since people may judge success through what they own.

In conclusion, both views are valid to a certain extent. Advertising can contribute to economic growth by stimulating demand, production and employment. At the same time, it can create dissatisfaction and encourage materialistic values among consumers.

Em đã có ví dụ Shopee, cần làm rõ câu chủ đề và chuỗi nguyên nhân.
Rà lại câu mở đầu và động từ số ít của bài này.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is believed by some people that the rewards should be given to the students who have the best academic results, others say that it is more important to reward students who show improvements. From my perspective, all kind of are worthy for the rewards, regardless the best students or the improvements students.

Admittedly, the rewards for the students who show the best results are right. It can be seen that when the school rewards to the students who have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they can deserve their praises and privileges, which may encourage these students and others to study harder and win the rewards. These activities can lead to propel towards overall academic gains. Furthermore, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded, thus students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, students can enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, school should reward the students who have improvements in studies. Only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards. This causes others to think that their efforts is futile, since, they can not surpass those outstanding individuals and prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened. It is naturally follows that, the students may gradually lose the incentive to study. In addition, by emphasizing improvements students, school can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves, even benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that the rewards should be given to all kind of students, regardless the students who have talented in studies or the students who have improvements. By emphasizing all kind of students, it can help the students to study harder and keep trying in studies.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết luận trên nguồn ảnh đủ trang.

review.overall: Em viết đủ bốn phần và chọn thưởng cả hai nhóm, song mức vận dụng câu văn còn yếu. Mở bài 'all kind of are worthy' thiếu danh từ; Body 1 ghép 'These activities can lead to propel' và 'students can enable them' sai khung; Body 2 có 'efforts is futile, since,' và 'by emphasizing improvements students'. Các lỗi nền tảng trải đều nhiều đoạn, khiến người đọc phải đoán quan hệ giữa người được thưởng, nỗ lực và kết quả. Bài làm còn cẩu thả ở khâu ghép câu và tự soát; em cần viết lại theo từng câu đủ chủ–vị, giải thích được vì sao mỗi khung sửa đúng. Em có hai nhánh trong mỗi Body và “Furthermore”, “In addition” đều làm đúng việc mở ý thứ hai. Phần còn thiếu là tín hiệu đưa người đọc từ câu chủ đề sang lý do đầu: “It can be seen that when” và “Only a few...” chưa làm rõ vai trò ấy.

paragraphs: It is believed by some people that rewards should be given to students who have the best academic results, while others say that it is more important to reward students who show improvements. From my perspective, both kinds of students deserve rewards: those with the best results and those who show improvement.

Admittedly, rewarding students who achieve the best results is justified. Initially, these students have diligently applied themselves to their studies and deserve their praises and privileges. This recognition may encourage them and others to study harder and win the rewards. This recognition may contribute to overall academic gains. Furthermore, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. Students can become used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition. This experience can enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, schools should reward students who make improvements in their studies. The first reason is that only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards. This causes others to think that their efforts are futile. This is because they may feel unable to surpass those outstanding individuals and become overwhelmed and disheartened. As a result, these students may gradually lose the incentive to study. In addition, by emphasizing students' improvements, schools can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves may even benefit them more than the competitive determination to win against all others.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that the rewards should be given to both groups of students, including those who excel academically and those who make improvements. By recognizing both groups, schools can help students study harder and keep trying in their studies.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: In some countries, parents are more preferred to teach their children at home instead of sending them to school. Although such development is beneficial to a certain extent, I believe that the disadvantages that it offers are far more pronounced.

Those who advocate homeschooling emphasise that it brings significantly benefits. Firstly, teaching children at home allows parents to save money. This can be seen in the way homeschooling are not required school fees. Secondly, educated children at home can less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure, which cause to emotional and mental problems. Finally, when parents teaching their children at home by themselves, they can tailor their curriculum and pedagogical approaches to best suit their young ones. which often not the case in traditional schooling because of the large of class size.

However, things that seem good can actually be harmful. At first, this educational approach not actually save money, conversely, parents need to pay a large of amount of money for lab equipment and tutors and one parents needs to be cut off. As a result, it can create a cater for their child's needs, be these academic or personal. Second, most parents are not well-versed in all school subjects, therefore, it can be difficult in properly explaining concepts for children and ultimately academic problems. At the end, even social problems that children is faced with at school such as: bullying and having romantic feelings for others. It naturally follows that they can prepare for social workplace situations in the future.

In conclusion, although it is true that teaching children at home may bring about a few advantages, these are relatively minor and should not overshadow the far more significant and long-lasting drawbacks it entails.
review.overall: Em trả lời đúng chiều hại hơn lợi và có ba hướng lợi, ba hướng hại. Body 1 còn các lỗi dựng câu như are more preferred, can less likely và which often not the case thiếu is. Ở Body 2, dấu phẩy nối nhiều mệnh đề; one parents sai số ít sau one, còn create a cater thiếu cấu trúc động từ. Nhánh xã hội là mảnh câu dù đã nêu đúng bullying và romantic feelings. Kết luận đã chọn rõ bên nào trội hơn; hãy giữ lập trường đó khi sửa chủ ngữ–động từ trong từng nhánh.

paragraphs: In some countries, more parents prefer to teach their children at home instead of sending them to school. Although this approach is beneficial to a certain extent, I believe that its disadvantages are far more pronounced.

Those who advocate homeschooling emphasise that it brings significant benefits. Firstly, teaching children at home may allow parents to save money as parents do not have to pay school fees. Secondly, children educated at home may be less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure, both of which can cause emotional and mental problems. Finally, parents who teach their children at home can tailor their curriculum and pedagogical approaches to best suit their young ones. This is often not the case in traditional schooling due to large class sizes.

However, these apparent benefits may be outweighed by drawbacks. First, homeschooling may not actually save money as parents may have to pay a large amount of money for laboratory equipment and tutors; one parent may also reduce paid work to meet the child's academic and personal needs. Second, most parents are not well-versed in every school subject; therefore, they may struggle to explain concepts to children, which can ultimately lead to academic problems. Finally, even social problems that children face at school, such as bullying and having romantic feelings for others, can prepare them for social and workplace situations in the future.

In conclusion, although it is true that teaching children at home may bring about a few advantages, these are relatively minor and should not overshadow the far more significant and long-lasting drawbacks it entails.
